resources.string: "Delete %1$s and its dated values? Cash, transactions, goals and saved net-worth snapshots stay unchanged."
"Delete this dated value? An earlier recorded value may become the latest; saved snapshots stay unchanged. Without any value, an active item becomes unknown, not zero."
"Delete this saved snapshot and its copied components? Current items, values and cash stay unchanged. Historical dates without a saved snapshot remain unavailable."

"Track non-cash, non-investment assets and manual liabilities. Do not enter ledger cash or investment holdings again as assets. Adding or valuing an item never creates a purchase, expense, loan payment or cash transfer."

"Tracked net worth = recorded ledger cash + latest recorded active asset values − latest recorded active liabilities. Goal earmarks remain part of cash and are not added or subtracted again. Non-cash assets do not increase Home spending cash."

"Investment holdings are excluded from this total. Contributions reduce recorded cash but do not prove a holding value. This tracked total excludes holdings and all unrecorded assets/debts; it is not a complete bank-verified wealth statement."
"Unknown active values: %1$s asset(s), %2$s liability item(s). Record a value or explicitly exclude the item before capturing a total."

"This copies today’s recorded cash and the latest dated active asset/liability values. Their original value dates stay visible. Later edits will not update this snapshot. Only one snapshot per ledger date is stored."
"These are saved observations, not a reconstructed daily history. Changes between captures can include cash edits, new items, exclusions and value corrections; they are not investment returns."
"Change between the latest two saved dates: %1$s"
"Captured at %1$s (UTC). Tracked assets/liabilities method v1; holdings excluded."
"Use the ledger currency and Indonesian notation, for example 25.000,50. Values and amounts owed may be zero but not negative. Future dates and dates before acquisition/opening are rejected."
"Cost is optional metadata only. Do not add it to the current value or create a duplicate cash expense. Item kind is fixed after creation."
"Excluding an item removes it only from the current tracked total. Dated values and saved snapshots stay intact; no sale or repayment is recorded."
"Check name (1–80 characters), kind/category, nonnegative amounts, notes (up to 500 characters) and valid dates. Kind is fixed; acquisition cannot move after an existing value date."
"An amount or aggregate exceeds the supported range. Unsupported totals cannot be captured."
"This item, value or snapshot no longer exists. Refresh the list."
"A tracked total is unavailable because cash or an active value is unknown. No snapshot was saved."
"This item already has a value on that date. Edit the existing observation or choose another date."
"Asset and net-worth data could not be read or saved. Try again."
"Current values and old on-screen totals are hidden until the data can be read again."
